{{Short description|British biologist and ornithologist}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
'''John Patrick Croxall''' {{post-nominals|country=GBR|size=100%|CBE|FRS}} (born 19 January 1946 in [[Birmingham]]) is a British [[biologist]],<ref>http://www.debretts.com/people/biographies/browse/c/25388/John%20Patrick+CROXALL.aspx {{Dead link|date=February 2022}}</ref> and was Head of Conservation Biology at the [[British Antarctic Survey]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.antarctica.ac.uk/about_bas/news/news_story.php?id=156|title=About - British Antarctic Survey|website=www.antarctica.ac.uk|access-date=7 December 2011|archive-date=7 July 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150707000847/http://www.antarctica.ac.uk/about_bas/news/news_story.php?id=156|url-status=dead}}</ref>
He is Chair of Global Seabird Programme, of [[BirdLife International]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.pacificseabirdgroup.org/index.php?f=PSG2008_Awards&t=2008+Awards&s=1|title=Search Results for "1" – Pacific Seabird Group|website=www.pacificseabirdgroup.org}}</ref>

==Life==
Croxall completed a PhD at the [[University of Auckland]] in 1971, on [[Ascidiacea|ascidian]] ecology, supervised by [[John Morton (zoologist)|John Morton]].<ref>{{cite thesis |last=Croxall |first=John |year=1971 |type=Doctoral thesis |title=Digestive system, feeding and ecology of some New Zealand intertidal ascidians |publisher=ResearchSpace@Auckland, University of Auckland |hdl=2292/772}}</ref> He was senior research associate in zoology, at the [[Newcastle University|University of Newcastle upon Tyne]] from 1972 to 1975. He won a Scientific Medal in 1984, from the [[Zoological Society of London]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://static.zsl.org/files/scientific-medal-winners-final-for-web-1513.pdf |title=Archived copy |access-date=7 December 2011 |archive-date=4 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304023954/http://static.zsl.org/files/scientific-medal-winners-final-for-web-1513.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref> He received a President’s Medal from the [[British Ecological Society]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.britishecologicalsociety.org/membership-community/honours-awards-and-prizes/presidents-medal-2/|title = Winners of our President's Medal}}</ref>
